title: Financial Analysis Long-Form Editorial Page
purpose: Test expressive editorial design hierarchy, typography pacing, and reading surfaces.
brief: Create a semantic, responsive HTML/CSS/JS article template featuring a high-density executive summary, interactive data callout cards, footnote toggles, and legible editorial typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic article structure with header, main, aside, and footer landmarks
Readable typography with clear fluid scale (16px body, 1.6 line-height, constrained 65ch measure)
High-contrast data callouts with monospaced metrics
Interactive footnote drawer/toggle operating via keyboard and ARIA disclosure
Zero layout shift across desktop (1280px), tablet (768px), and mobile (375px)
Clean CSS without external unpinned framework bloat

title: Multi-Tenant Telemetry Operations Console
purpose: Test high-density information architecture, tabular alignment, and real-time status readability.
brief: Implement a high-density real-time system operations dashboard with a 4-metric summary bar, sortable node telemetry table, interactive filter tags, and visual status badges.
acceptanceCriteria: Dense tabular layout displaying 10+ node records with status, latency, CPU, and memory
Compact monospaced numerical formatting with right-aligned tabular figures
Keyboard-accessible table header sorting with aria-sort attributes
Filter tags that toggle cluster views instantly (< 16ms)
Monochrome / crisp border hierarchy without gradients or decorative blurs
Responsive horizontal overflow containment with sticky column headers

title: Accessible Multi-Select Tag Combobox with Live Region
purpose: Test strict WCAG AA/AAA compliance, focus trapping, and ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern.
brief: Build a fully accessible headless multi-select autocomplete tag component compliant with WAI-ARIA 1.2 Combobox pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete ARIA combobox markup (role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant)
Full keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/Up navigation, Enter selection, Escape close, Backspace chip removal)
Dynamic aria-live region announcing filtered count and active item updates
Visible high-contrast focus rings on all interactive tags and inputs
Reduced-motion awareness for dropdown transitions
Zero keyboard traps; clean tab order restoration on blur

title: Adaptive Multi-Pane Workspace Layout
purpose: Test adaptive screen-size layout shifts, navigation rails vs bottom bars, and fold awareness.
brief: Implement an adaptive responsive product layout conforming to Material 3 Adaptive window size classes (Compact < 600px, Medium 600-840px, Expanded > 840px).
acceptanceCriteria: Expanded (> 840px): Persistent navigation rail (72px) with dual-pane master-detail view
Medium (600-840px): Collapsible modal navigation rail with flexible pane split
Compact (< 600px): Bottom navigation bar (80px) with single-pane stacked navigation and back button
Touch target sizes >= 48x48px on compact and medium viewports
Fluid transitions between window size classes without state or input loss
Accessible semantic structure with proper landmark scoping

title: Refactor Bloated Form with Broken Hierarchy & Missing Labels
purpose: Test refactoring, diagnosis of anti-patterns, and removal of speculative abstractions.
brief: Diagnose and refactor a legacy settings form suffering from div-soup, missing form labels, non-standard click handlers on divs, hardcoded inline styles, and unstyled error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor div-soup into semantic <form>, <fieldset>, <legend>, and <label> elements
Associate every input with explicit label matching for="id" and proper aria-describedby for error messages
Replace un-keyboard-accessible <div> buttons with native <button type="submit">
Eliminate 30+ redundant inline style attributes in favor of clean structured CSS classes
Implement accessible inline field validation with assertive error summary
Maintain exact existing form fields and values without data loss

title: In-Memory Cache Layer with LRU Eviction & Safe Seams
purpose: Test global and contextual engineering rules (YAGNI, stdlib primacy, test seams) in pure code architecture without UI.
brief: Implement a high-performance in-memory LRU cache in modern TypeScript/JavaScript without external dependencies. Provide bounded memory size, O(1) get/set, TTL expiration, and an explicit testable storage seam.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero external dependencies (pure standard library Map/DoublyLinkedList)
O(1) average complexity for get, set, and has operations
LRU eviction strictly enforced when capacity limit is reached
Time-to-live (TTL) expiration on entries with lazy or periodic cleanup
Isolate persistence/clock behind an explicit mockable interface for deterministic unit testing
Passes 100% of accompanying unit tests for concurrency and cache invalidation

title: Phased Migration Plan & Forensic Architecture Contract

Explicit gate conditions and rollback criteria for each execution phase
Traceable requirement matrix mapping capabilities to verification tests
Dependency-ordered wave parallelization matrix
Post-mortem forensic checkpoint definitions
Zero hand-waving: every migration phase specifies exact inputs, outputs, and halt triggers
